process_method: Release --features demo with --demo --demo-server-settings; default 1120x760 logical window, Wgpu. Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden; visibility/occlusion and actual adapter unverified. 5s warmup then 20 samples/500ms. Concurrent parent/other task compiler processes detected and recorded: timing confounded, no improvement/regression attribution. CPU is process timer resolution; GPU allocations/frame p95/startup latency unmeasured.
limitations: Concurrent builds were observed in both baseline and after replay/process samples; timings do not isolate this change.
Offline framebuffer exports are synthetic and do not prove native input/accessibility or live Discord interoperability.
GPU allocations, startup latency and frame-time p95 were not measured.
